title: Abandoned daily-pick worker can still save and record a prediction before the timeout hold lands
rule: Pass is_cancelled into get_or_create_today_pick; abort before _save when the scheduler generation has moved. PR #1304 build_started_at disk guard remains the cross-process backstop.
finding: pick_scheduler._tick compared _work_generation only after get_or_create_today_pick returned. FuturesTimeoutError bumped the generation while the worker could still reach _save and record_pick_prediction before write_scheduler_hold landed.
fix: is_cancelled callback checked immediately before _save in daily_pick_engine.get_or_create_today_pick; pick_scheduler passes lambda comparing _work_generation to the tick generation captured at worker start.
recommendation: Keep the build_started_at check-then-write as the cross-process backstop alongside the pre-save cancellation gate.
